title: Appearance
description: Colors, transparency, fonts and theming from the wallpaper.

sections.title: Color
sections.description: Light or dark theme and how the palette is taken from the wallpaper.

sections.title: Transparency
sections.description: See-through bar and panels; turn it off for the clearest text.

sections.title: Typography
sections.description: Font families used across the shell.

sections.title: Colors from the wallpaper
sections.description: Generated each time the wallpaper changes; Apply now shows a change at once.

sections.title: Shell windows
sections.description: Windows of the shell itself, such as this Settings window.

entries.label: Theme
entries.description: Light or dark colors from the current wallpaper; Ctrl+Super+Shift+D switches them anywhere.

entries.label: Color scheme
entries.description: How the palette is built from the wallpaper; Auto picks Neutral for dull wallpapers and Tonal spot for the rest.

options.label: Auto
options.description: Neutral for wallpapers with little color, Tonal spot for the rest.

options.label: Content
options.description: Colors close to the wallpaper's own, with their saturation.

options.label: Expressive
options.description: Hues shifted away from the wallpaper for a bolder look.

options.label: Fidelity
options.description: Keeps the wallpaper's main color as exact as possible.

options.label: Fruit Salad
options.description: A playful mix of hues rotated away from the wallpaper's color.

options.label: Neutral
options.description: Almost grey, with a faint tint of the wallpaper's color.

options.label: Tonal Spot
options.description: Calm, slightly muted colors from the wallpaper; the Material You default.

entries.label: Accent color
entries.description: Base the palette on this color instead of the wallpaper; leave empty to follow the wallpaper.
entries.note: Applied the next time colors are generated, or with Apply now.

entries.label: Extra background tint
entries.description: Mix a touch of the accent color into the bar and panel backgrounds.

entries.label: See-through bar and panels
entries.description: The bar, sidebars and other panels let the wallpaper and windows behind them show through.

entries.label: Automatic amount
entries.description: Set the amount from the wallpaper colors; turn it off to choose the two amounts below by hand.

entries.label: Background transparency
entries.description: How see-through the bar and panel backgrounds are; 0 % is solid.

entries.label: Card and button transparency
entries.description: How see-through the cards and buttons inside panels are; 0 % is solid.

entries.label: Main
entries.description: Text of most of the shell.

entries.label: Titles
entries.description: Headings of dialogs and pages, the power menu and the rotating date of the analog clock.

entries.label: Numbers
entries.description: Clocks, percentages and other figures.

entries.label: Monospace
entries.description: Code and terminal-like text.

entries.label: Nerd Font icons
entries.description: Icon glyphs in buttons and in workspace labels; it must be a Nerd Font.

entries.label: Reading
entries.description: The quote under the analog clock and its big hour numbers.

entries.label: Display
entries.description: Large text such as the analog clock digits, the digital clock's date and quote, and the weather widget.

entries.label: Shell and apps
entries.description: Recolor the shell, GTK apps, window borders, the lock screen and fuzzel with each wallpaper.
entries.help: Turn it off to keep the current colors when the wallpaper changes.

entries.label: Qt apps
entries.description: Also recolor Qt and KDE apps through the KDE color scheme.

entries.label: Terminal colors
entries.description: Also recolor kitty and every terminal that is open.

entries.label: Accent tint in the terminal
entries.description: How far each terminal color turns toward the accent hue; 0 % keeps the original colors.

entries.label: Maximum color shift
entries.description: Caps how many degrees of hue a terminal color can turn toward the accent; 0 keeps them all.
entries.help: A low value keeps red, green and yellow recognizable while the accent still tints them a little.

entries.label: Terminal color contrast
entries.description: Make terminal colors brighter in dark mode, or darker in light mode, so they stand out from the background.

entries.label: Dark terminal in light mode
entries.description: Keep terminal colors dark even when the shell is light.

entries.label: Apply to the current wallpaper
entries.description: Regenerate the colors now instead of waiting for the next wallpaper change.

entries.label: Title bar
entries.description: Show a title bar on the shell's own windows, such as Settings and the welcome app.

entries.label: Center the title
entries.description: Center the text of that title bar.

entries.label: Rounded screen corners
entries.description: Draw rounded corners over the edges of the screen, like a display with rounded corners.

options.label: Not in fullscreen
options.description: Hidden while a window is fullscreen.
